tip: сказав (skazav = having said) is a verbal adverb for a second action by one subject; не сказав (ne skazav) means without saying.
For a reported yes/no question, put ли (li = whether) right after the verb: могу ли (mogu li = whether I can).
Будьте любезны (budte lyubezny = be so kind) plus an infinitive like передать (peredat = to pass) makes a formal polite request.
так (tak = so) paired with что (chto = that) links a degree to a result, as in так рад, что (tak rad, chto = so glad that).
In до тех пор пока ... не (do tekh por poka ... ne = until), the final не (ne) is not a real negation: не позвонит (ne pozvonit) marks until he calls.
After a comparative like умнее (umnee = smarter), чем (chem = than) introduces the comparison.
как бы ни (kak by ni = no matter how) sets up a concession: как бы ни было трудно (kak by ni bylo trudno = no matter how hard).
С тех пор как (s tekh por kak = since) marks a starting point in time, unlike так как (tak kak = because) which gives a reason.
Paired comparatives use the frame Чем больше ..., тем больше (chem bolshe ..., tem bolshe = the more ..., the more).
не только ..., но и (ne tolko ..., no i = not only ..., but also) is a fixed correlative pair joining two facts about one subject.
чтобы (chtoby = in order to) plus an infinitive shows purpose: чтобы помочь (chtoby pomoch = in order to help).
